test_dataframe_dot: test the DataFrame.dot method for matrix multiplication between two DataFrames
test_series_dot: test the Series.dot method for dot product between a Series and a DataFrame
test_dot_ndarray_argument: test the dot method with 2D and 1D numpy ndarray arguments
test_dot_index_alignment: test that the dot method correctly aligns indices when multiplying DataFrames or Series
test_dot_shape_mismatch_error: test that the dot method raises an exception on shape mismatch
test_dot_misaligned_matrices_error: test that the dot method raises ValueError on misaligned matrices
test_arrow_dtype_dot: test the dot method with Arrow dtypes such as Float32, Int16, and float[pyarrow]
